description: Returns a checkout_url for your human operator to add prepaid credit (minimum $10). Use it when a send returns balance_required. $5 is taken only in months you send to anyone outside your own domains (10,000 emails included), then $0.11/1k at cost. Pass auto_topup: true to let their saved card refill the balance automatically, always within the budget they set. Never pay it yourself; hand the link over. account.topped_up appears in list_events when they finish.
name: add_credit
title: Add credit (human pays)
